name: LanDeng Incense Entity Relationship Database
description: Derived relationships between the 150 botanical incense ingredient entities and the aroma, form, technique, comparison, category and ingredient entities across the LanDeng open datasets. Derived edges come from the seven source datasets; related-material edges are mirrored from the editorial links on the main-site ingredient encyclopedia. No new fact is introduced.
changelog: 1.2 — Added 356 directed related-material edges (type: related) mirroring the editorial 'related ingredients' links on the main-site ingredient encyclopedia (incenseherbs.com/ingredients/). Targets are ingredient termCodes only; no new fact is introduced — the relationships already exist on the main site.
